_comment: Per-mission perf budget seeded from Baseline A (82add3ca, post-8z, mc2-win64-0.4c). Floors/ceilings carry margin because headless idle fly-throughs are noisy: avg_fps_floor ~=0.85x baseline, p99_ms_ceil ~=1.5x baseline (tail noisy), p1low_fps_floor ~=0.7x baseline (very noisy). p99_ms is the STEADY-STATE tail; peak_ms is intentionally NOT budgeted (it captures the one-time load/first-frame hitch). Update only with a new committed baseline + rationale. See docs/perf-budget.md.
